frames.Wv: vendor URDF world/root frame; not the firmware Cartesian frame
frames.R_u: vendor URDF base_link frame; not assumed coincident with Wv or R_ctrl
frames.R_ctrl: firmware T=104/T=1051 Cartesian frame; independently correlate to the installed arm
frames.E: installation-specific camera-carrier frame rigidly attached to vendor link2
frames.holder: bundled Waveshare camera-holder mechanical frame at its measured rail position
frames.B: RC03 board frame, origin at front-left finished top surface; +x right, +y rear, +z up

frame_separation.rule: No URDF pose may become a controller Cartesian command until configuration-dependent R_ctrl correlation and residual bounds are commissioned.

camera_installation.camera: Waveshare IMX335 5MP USB Camera (B), SKU 26719 selected-unqualified candidate

motion_t104.spd_interpretation: controller coefficient, not physical Cartesian speed

required_before_motion: joint signs, limits, installed zero offsets, and commissioned reference procedure
validated FK and source hashes from Wv through R_u, E, G, and route-specific T
measured link2_T_holder and holder_T_C_arm at the locked rail position
measured B_T_Wv and independently qualified R_ctrl controller-model correlation
route TCP/compliance, empty-cell pose, command, load, power-loss, and collision characterization
